scripts.dev: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed && node --env-file=.env ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js --kill-others-on-fail -n web,api,parser -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @orbito/web" "npm run dev -w @orbito/api" "npm run dev:parser"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @orbito/api && npm run build -w @orbito/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @orbito/api && npm run typecheck -w @orbito/web
scripts.db:push: node --env-file=.env scripts/prepare-sqlite.mjs && node --env-file=.env ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db push --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
